## paramiko / openssh (SSH for Hetzner)
- **Note**: Determinex does NOT use paramiko. All SSH is via system `ssh`/`scp` binaries
  (OpenSSH) called via `subprocess.run`. This is intentional — no Python SSH library
  means no Python-layer MITM risk; host key verification is handled by OpenSSH directly.
- **Verdict**: **APPROVED** (OpenSSH — system package, audited by OS vendor)
- **Reviewer**: Ryan Gurganious — 2026-06-07
